# Security

Please report a vulnerability privately, through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/renplay-org/renplay/security/advisories/new),
not in a public issue. Say what is affected, how to reproduce it, and what it lets someone do.

The Renplay Team answers within a week. Fixes ship in a patch release of the newest version, and the
advisory is published once a release with the fix is out.

Only the newest release gets security fixes. Renplay is meant to run for yourself and the people you
trust: keep it behind HTTPS outside your own network
([Reverse proxy and HTTPS](https://docs.renplay.org/install/reverse-proxy/)).
